component.name: OpenCutter
component.summary: Send SVG designs to Silhouette cutters

description.p: OpenCutter cuts, draws and scores your SVG designs on a Silhouette cutting machine over Bluetooth, from Linux. It is tested on the CAMEO 4. Draw in Inkscape or any SVG editor, place the design on the cutting mat, choose Material, Action and Tool, load the mat and press Send.

ul.li: Cutting mat view with the cut area, media size and placement by drag, scale and rotate
Material presets: a small built-in set or your own presets file, and Cut Settings for every other material
Tool check before every job, an optional outline preview with the tool up, and a large Cancel Job button

description.p: OpenCutter is experimental. It has cut designs on one real CAMEO 4 (firmware V5.05), but stopping a running cut, pausing and resuming a job, and where a design lands against the printed grid of the mat have not been checked on a real machine yet. Use the outline preview and scrap material for your first jobs.

OpenCutter reads the model and firmware the machine reports. Not yet tested: it also drives the CAMEO 4 Plus, CAMEO 4 Pro, CAMEO 5, CAMEO 5 Plus, CAMEO Pro MK-II, CAMEO 5 Alpha, CAMEO 5 Alpha Plus, Portrait 3 and Portrait 4, and the CAMEO 4 with firmware V1.xx, none of which has been run with it yet. Recognized, not supported yet: the CURIO 2, the CAMEO 3, the Portrait 2 and older USB-only models get no job.
Tested with the Silhouette CAMEO 4. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Silhouette America, Inc. Silhouette, CAMEO, Portrait and CURIO are trademarks of their respective owners.

description.p: The machine's Pause key now pauses the job instead of ending it. While the machine is paused, OpenCutter sends it nothing but status queries and waits, for as long as it takes; press the Pause key again and the job goes on from where it stopped.

ul.li: Resume and Pause buttons in the job view, for the CAMEO 4 with firmware V5, and the commands opencutter resume and opencutter pause
Cancel Job while the machine is paused: the job view shows "Cancelling…" until the machine has ended the job, about 5 seconds after the stop
A job is no longer ended when the machine answers slowly: OpenCutter keeps waiting and sends nothing new, and the app says "Checking connection" when no answer has come for 7 seconds

description.p: How the machine pauses, goes on and ends a paused job comes from an analysis of the CAMEO 4's firmware. None of these changes has been tried on a real machine yet: keep the power button within reach, and please report how it went on the bug tracker.

The first release. OpenCutter opens SVG designs, places them on the cutting mat and cuts, draws or scores them on a Silhouette cutter over Bluetooth LE, with a tool check before every job, an optional outline preview and Cancel Job always on screen.

Tested on one CAMEO 4 with firmware V5.05. OpenCutter also drives these, which have not been tested on a real machine yet: the CAMEO 4 Plus and Pro, the CAMEO 5, 5 Plus and Pro MK-II, the CAMEO 5 Alpha and Alpha Plus, the Portrait 3 and 4, and the CAMEO 4 with firmware V1.xx.
If you own one of them, please report how it went on the bug tracker: "Reporting a model" in the project's CONTRIBUTING.md lists what helps.
